# NovaPharm Healthcare
> Official public pages for NovaPharm Healthcare Ltd, a UK healthcare and pharmaceutical business. This is a navigational guide for readers and AI-assisted search tools, not an independent source of regulatory approval or commercial authorisation.

## Official company and identity
- [Official website](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/): Corporate overview and published capabilities
- [Company](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/about/): Corporate background and operating context
- [Leadership](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/leadership/): Named leadership biographies
- [Governance](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/about/governance/): Public governance information
- [Capabilities](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/capabilities/): Services and operating scope
- [Contact](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/contact/): Official business contact route

## Nutraxin UK food supplements
- [Nutraxin product collection](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/products/nutraxin/): Browse the 19 listed food supplement products and product detail pages
- [Products overview](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/products/): Consumer supplement and separate pharmaceutical portfolio navigation
- [Vitamin D3 + K2, 120 tablets](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/products/nutraxin/vitamin-d3-k2-120-tablets/): Example individual product with pack details and current published UK price
- [Magnesium Complex + Vitamin B6, 60 tablets](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/products/nutraxin/magnesium-complex-60-tablets/): Example individual product with supplier-transcribed composition

## Index and boundaries
- [Canonical XML sitemap](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/sitemap.xml): Public indexable URL inventory
- [Editorial and legal standards](https://novapharmhealthcare.com/legal/): Source and content governance
- Product availability, medicines authorisations, regulatory status and health claims should be assessed from the current official product pages and competent authorities, not assumed from this guide.
- Private account, portal, internal documentation and customer records are not public reference sources.
- Discovery and citation by any third-party search engine or AI assistant is controlled by that service; publication of this guide does not guarantee indexing, inclusion, ranking or endorsement.
